question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7d98971f108d696e1fd1fea358bf7a297580772c1dc34525d7b54e00037ae440.png]
solution:
The image that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series is as shown below :

 
• The symbol " [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2bca4ef2dafb900cf393677942187a001639d9186c8ba0908c009756eb27bde9.png] " is rotated 90⁰ clockwise from figure to figure.
 
• The symbol " [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2bca4ef2dafb900cf393677942187a001639d9186c8ba0908c009756eb27bde9.png] " is added from figure 2 and rotated 90⁰ Anti-clockwise.
 
• The process is repeated by adding the symbol " [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2bca4ef2dafb900cf393677942187a001639d9186c8ba0908c009756eb27bde9.png] " and one rotates clockwise and other rotates Anti-clockwise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4bf9ab6849731f766c193a7ddf4968812aa0816d63821e91bcec4ca2398a8ea4.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
